name: Band Seated Row
steps: Sit tall on the floor with your legs extended straight, loop a resistance band across your arches, and hold an end in each hand.
Brace your core, sit upright with a neutral spine, and start with your arms extended forward.
Pull both elbows smoothly back alongside your waist while squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly toward your feet without letting the band pull your shoulders into a slouch.
tips: Keep the band anchored across the middle arches of your feet so it cannot slip off your toes.
Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears throughout the pull.
